summary: The first vote is at eighteen, told as a plain fact.
realLife: A Iowa man said he turned eighteen in spring 1972, after the voting age dropped from twenty-one, and voted for the first time.
sources: Smithsonian Museum on Main Street, Voting Runs in the Family in West Branch, Iowa (story 1592): https://museumonmainstreet.org/sites/default/files/stories/1592/votingrunsinthefamily1592.pdf
inGame: `life:came-of-age` and the player's first vote record. The game opens at eighteen unless the player picks another age.

turns.writesBack: the line says the writer let it pass

turns.pulledBy: the first race's result against the writer's side
